description: Fetch a reviewed public page and return its title, every meta and Open Graph tag, and the canonical URL. No JavaScript is executed and no script content is read. Returns the licence and creator for the content alongside it, so reuse terms travel with the result. Pay 4000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

url.description: HTTPS URL on a reviewed public origin. Permitted origins: https://docs.python.org, https://developer.mozilla.org, https://en.wikipedia.org, https://www.cisa.gov, https://www.sec.gov, https://home.treasury.gov, https://books.toscrape.com. robots.txt is honoured and redirects are refused.

name: page_metadata

attribution.description: Licence and creator for the retrieved content. Reusing it is subject to these terms.

limits.description: The bounds this service applies, declared so a caller can tell a short page from a truncated one.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

warnings.description: Named limits that were reached, so truncation is never silent.

title: Page Metadata
